about: Declarations the source analysis would move but a Linux build of BlastModel showed must stay in BlastCore, each with its reason. Keys are `File.swift:unit` or `File.swift:unit/member`, as in classification.json.

stay.ElevationGrid.swift:extension ElevationG: it calls TIFFReader.raster, which inflates Deflate-compressed GeoTIFFs with Apple's Compression library (found by the Linux build: the analysis cannot follow a member called on a value)
stay.EnvelopeDebris.swift:struct EnvelopeDebr: it calls the other make(loads:components:...), which stays (found by the Linux build: the analysis does not tell overloads apart)
stay.ImportInteractionTests.swift:struct Impo: one of its tests writes to /private/tmp, which exists on macOS only (found by running BlastModelTests on Linux)
